selection.note: Representative diagnosis choices for fixture conditions and world outpatient, ED, inpatient, pediatric and surgical workflows. Fixture Conditions use SNOMED CT; this is not an automatic SNOMED-to-ICD crosswalk. Injury laterality, encounter suffixes, obstetric details, and coding specificity must be selected from the chart. Social findings such as employment/education are not necessarily diagnoses.
